name: How long does a polybutylene pipe replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a polybutylene pipe replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a polybutylene pipe replacement depends on the complexity and size of your home. A typical whole-house re-pipe can take anywhere from 3 to 7 days. Factors like the number of fixtures, the number of stories, and the ease of access to existing plumbing lines influence the timeline. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption to your daily routine, often completing the water shut-off for only a portion of the project. We will provide a more precise timeline during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full replacement typically takes 3-7 days, depending on home size, complexity, and access. We minimize disruption during the process.
